conbody.p: Smart fields, smart clauses, read-only fields, and read-only clauses in a contract document are represented in Microsoft Word with content control, that is with a bounding box. You can control the visibility of bounding boxes using theHide Smart Boundary and Show Smart Boundary options. The Hide Smart Boundary and Show Smart Boundary options are visible based on the Hide Content Control Border custom setting. For more information, see Admin Settings for X-Author for Contracts Advanced. The following table provides the details about which option is displayed based on the Hide Content Control Border custom setting:

entry.p: Hide Content Control Border custom setting when generating or checking-in the document
All smart boundaries are hidden while checking-out the document.
All smart boundaries are shown while checking-out the document.

You can control the visibility of bounding boxes using theHide Smart Boundary and Show Smart Boundary options. The Hide Smart Boundary and Show Smart Boundary options are visible based on the Hide Content Control Border custom setting in the Conga CLM. Your administrator can configure the custom setting. For more information on configuring custom settings, see Comply System Properties topic in CLM for Administrators. entry.p: Hide Content Control Border custom setting when generating or checking-in the document
